annotations.title: Take a published post down (unpublish or delete)

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] TAKES A LIVE POST DOWN from real accounts. `takedown`: "unpublish" (per platform; `platforms` = "facebook,linkedin" to pick, default every live platform that allows it) or "delete" (the whole post). Two steps: call it first WITHOUT `confirm` to get the plan (status "confirm-required", nothing changed), show it to the user, then repeat with `confirm: true`. Refused while a running boost / ad uses the post (ad_running): offer to pause the ad first, or pass `acknowledgeAds: true` if the user accepts that the ad breaks. flayr's post follows (each platform marked, cancelled once none is live). Answers per platform `ok` and `confirmation`. For a scheduled (not yet live) post use cancel_scheduled_post. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) and the Pro plan or higher. Every call is audited.
(Wraps DELETE /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

acknowledgeAds.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. LIVE post: go ahead although a running boost / ad uses it.

confirm.description: Format: boolean; e.g. false. LIVE post: true to really take it down; otherwise only the plan.

id.description: Format: string; e.g. "id_123". The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

platforms.description: Format: string; e.g. "Example". LIVE post, takedown=unpublish: comma-separated platforms (default: every live platform that allows it).

takedown.description: Format: string; e.g. "unpublish". LIVE post only: how to take it down.

name: take_down_post
